purpose: Versioned amendment for the domain-adaptation experiment. This freezes the executable FP32/MPS recipe without authorizing corpus merge, training, checkpoint promotion, serving or deployment.

predecessor.superseded_clause: §7 LoRA rank 16, BF16, effective batch 8, one epoch

owner_decision.decision: Use the existing full-backbone FP32/MPS runtime as the proposed experimental amendment.
does_not_mean: deployment or active context removal authorized

runtime.mps_precision_rule: MPS accepts fp32 only; bf16 is rejected by resolve_runtime.
runtime.loss_rule: MPS rejects paired_brier_pg; this protocol uses gold_distribution with ce. The trainer also exposes brier, but brier is not selected by this protocol.

explicit_vs_runtime_defaults.steps: explicitly frozen and equal to runtime default
explicit_vs_runtime_defaults.eval_every: explicitly frozen and equal to runtime default
explicit_vs_runtime_defaults.backbone_lr: explicitly frozen and equal to runtime default
explicit_vs_runtime_defaults.head_lr: explicitly frozen and equal to runtime default
explicit_vs_runtime_defaults.batch_questions: explicit amendment; differs from runtime default 12
explicit_vs_runtime_defaults.max_length: explicit amendment; differs from runtime default 512
explicit_vs_runtime_defaults.device: explicit amendment; differs from historical runtime default cuda
explicit_vs_runtime_defaults.precision: explicit amendment; differs from historical runtime default bf16

data_and_split_contract.engineering_corpus: new reviewed version required; V1 is blocked and immutable
data_and_split_contract.source_group_unit: connected component of contrastive lineage plus identical canonical model-visible input
data_and_split_contract.heldout_and_ood: must be independently sourced and source-group disjoint from train, dev and calibration
data_and_split_contract.t8g_t9_gate: must pass a new isolation/provenance review before any trainer invocation

selection_and_reporting.last_point_rule: If the minimum is the final registered evaluation point, report budget exhaustion and lack of convergence; do not add steps after observing results.
selection_and_reporting.aggregate_rule: minimum across seeds for promotion gates; retain every seed and every failure

paired_gates.g5_rule: all gates hold for the minimum of seeds 17, 18 and 19

review_requirements: independent reviewer accepts this new protocol version and hash
new corpus version passes source-group and evaluation-provenance review
adapter mapping, endpoint identities and heldout composition are frozen
baseline is measured before candidate training
training outputs use a new directory and cannot overwrite production
